d:
In this interview, Jan Suraaj candidate from Mokama, Piyush Priyadarshi, speaks to Bhupinder Soni about the brutal murder of Dularchand Yadav.
Piyush Priyadarshi makes serious allegations against Bahubali leader Anant Singh and questions the role of the police in the investigation. He also talks about the political situation in Mokama, an assembly seat in Patna district, and how this incident could influence the Bihar Assembly Elections, especially the Mokama seat.
